title.narrative: Norec, FK Norway, post exchange initiative

description.narrative: The main goal of this project is to reduce organic waste while improving food security and livelihoods for youth and women. Within 6 months, at least 40 participants will gain practical skills in composting, Black Soldier Fly rearing, and small-space farming, enabling them to grow nutritious food and generate income even with limited land. A community demonstration hub will showcase these practices, serving as a learning and inspiration center. Expected outcomes include a measurable reduction in unmanaged organic waste, increased access to affordable food, and new income opportunities for youth and women. The project will also strengthen awareness on sustainable consumption, nutrition, and climate resilience.
